_comment: Seed data for the erasure tests: one user with data in every category of the erasure inventory, one bystander whose data must survive. All names, emails and ids are fictional.
_usage: Use in delete-account.feature, partial-failure.feature and the registry completeness test. Table names are examples; map them to your schema.

other_user._comment: Bystander. Must be unchanged after user-001 is deleted, except that user-001 disappears from this user's friend list.

friend_code_owned_by_someone_else._comment: Corrupted-profile case: user-001's profile points at a code that belongs to user-002. The eraser must NOT delete it.

post_deletion_expectations._comment: State after a completed deletion of user-001.
